scope: Phase A bounded commissioning and paged map foundations
checks: Actual CLI build-twin on a raw translating/rotating recording publishes and reloads corrected ray authority
Raw recordings are preserved while prepared RGB-D observations replay from disk
Orphan recording chunks and active/interrupted leases cannot be overwritten
Full measured point/occupancy histories survive tile LRU eviction and process reopening
Byte/page/disk/point/grid budgets fail explicitly rather than silently dropping history
Camera exposure poses and Brown rectification are used for tiled TSDF, while navigation uses original measured rays
Every persisted TSDF tile can be exported without a full-world mesh merge; IDs and bounds include distant tiles
Synthetic provenance overrides independently measured calibration and raw-file corruption fails integrity verification
Requested planning regions retain unknown cells and distinguish resource exhaustion from physical no-path
Exact full-store nearest queries find surfaces omitted from a capped preview, including regions10km apart
Expired evidence becomes unknown immediately without whole-cache writes on ordinary query/update
limits: Sliding pose-graph window is globally anchored; no unbounded retired-keyframe loop optimization is claimed
TSDF optical-depth limit is explicitly6m; previews have separate point/mesh caps
Global exact nearest-distance search is memory bounded but can be slow; default2m search is exact within radius and returns inf beyond it
Cache byte budgets exclude separately bounded observation, codec, native geometry and SQLite working buffers
